'''Colicoid''' was the official [[Language/Legends|language]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Colla IV/Legends|Colla IV]], used by its native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

Colicoid language used sounds produced by the antennae and jointed legs of the Colicoids, including humming sounds and clicks. This made difficult for other species to reproduce this language.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

Colicoid language did not have a written form, but almost all Colicoids were fluent in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and, somehow, managed to use Basic alphabet to reproduce the sounds of Colicoid language. When speaking Basic, Colicoids had a noticeable buzz as an accent.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />

Colicoids customarily spoke among themselves in Colicoid language, even when other species were seeing them. They considered that these strangers would not like to hear the plots they were scheming against them.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
